page._comment: World-coord bounds of the orange title-block border (page 1). Pages stack vertically with no gap at page_height intervals. page_count is how many borders the template provides; the layout engine fills them top-down (rows_per_page rows per border, serpentine within each page).

layout._comment: Coordinates in INCHES. Valves flow left-to-right across the row in SAV→GEX→FEV→AUX order, wrapping to a new row below when the next block would exceed (anchor_x + max_row_width). max_row_width tuned so right edge of last block stays inside page.x_max=1545 (anchor_x=101.69 + 1400 = 1501.69, leaving ~43" of right-edge clearance).

align_offsets._comment: Per-variant Y nudge (inches) applied to bbox-bottom Y when placing. Positive = shift block UP. Use to align visible elements (FUME HOOD vs CAGE WASH, etc.) when the source DWGs have those features at slightly different internal heights. Defaults to 0 for unlisted variants.

mstp._comment: Per-variant ACM/comm-bus port offsets, originally hand-measured then refreshed via tools/anchored_refresh.py (run after any straighten_polylines pass that may have nudged rail vertices). 'in_offset' missing on _START variants because they begin the comm trunk and have no IN port. wire_width is the polyline width to draw (matches the existing rail at 1 7/8").

cross_page_wire_margin._comment: Cross-page MSTP wires route through a vertical column in the page's left margin so they wrap around the title block. 'inward' = inches inside the page's left edge (used when layout._page_bounds is set). 'anchor_fallback' = anchor_x - this many inches (used when _page_bounds isn't set). 'default' = absolute X (used when no layout is passed at all).

pbc._comment: Geometry of the PBC body and per-valve sub-blocks. These values MUST agree with the DWG geometry generated by tools/generate_pbc_blocks.py — both files load this section, so updating here propagates to both runtime drawing and block re-generation. per_page is the maximum PBCs that lay out side-by-side on one page; beyond it, PBCs wrap to additional pages.
